description: This file defines an abstract class 'EventBusTenantAdapter' that acts as a bridge between a TenantService and the Vert.x event bus, handling tenant-related API requests such as 'get'. It manages request validation, tracing spans, and invokes the underlying service, providing a structure for subclasses to implement specific tenant service logic.

classes.name: EventBusTenantAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class integrating TenantService with the Vert.x event bus. Provides request processing, tracing, and tenant data retrieval functionalities, intended to be subclassed for specific tenant service implementations.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the TenantService instance; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the event bus address for tenant messages, fixed value from constants.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming tenant API requests by dispatching based on operation type ('get' or custom).

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Processes a 'get' tenant request, validates parameters, manages tracing, and delegates to specific retrieval methods.

methods.name: processGetByIdRequest
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information by tenant ID through the TenantService and constructs the response.

methods.name: processGetByCaRequest
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on a Subject DN, parsing the DN and invoking the TenantService.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new tracing span for operations, tagging with tenant ID if available.

methods.name: processCustomTenantMessage
methods.description: Default handler for unsupported custom operations, returns a failure future indicating bad request.
